integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained. No numerical experiment, finite enumeration, or external certificate is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives upper bounds only; optimality for \(n\ge3\) or infinite index sets is not claimed. The proof is restricted to \(1<p<\infty\) and nonzero real summands.
title: Cardinality-sensitive convex-combination thickness in \(\ell_p\)-sums
